theater: 興慶府、河西走廊與河套

battle.name: 蒙古攻西遼之戰
battle.theater: 興慶府、河西走廊與河套
battle.brief: 1217年，蒙古再伐西夏：成吉思汗掃平乃蠻、蔑兒乞後，騎兵自河套出發攻向興慶府，沿河西走廊掃蕩甘肅沙三州，逼西夏割地納貢、開關通行，為1219年西征花剌子模鋪路。弩喺呢場戰爭只係配角：守方以神臂弓壓住城堞，攻城方靠弩手齊射掩護填壕，真正決定走廊易手嘅係馬群、粟米同關隘。

kit.name: 十字弩
kit.history: 弩把射速交給了機械，代價是裝填慢。城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱。

countries: 交戰雙方是蒙古大汗國與西夏王朝（唐兀）。蒙古一方，1216年秋成吉思汗在漠南掃平乃蠻、蔑兒乞之後轉向正西，兵鋒直指興慶府；軍隊以蒙古本部千戶、百戶為骨幹，騎兵居主，攻城則大量徵用漢地、契丹、女真的降附將士與匠人，專司填壕、架梯、鑿穴、操砲。1217年蒙古在東西兩線同時用兵：東線由成吉思汗自率中軍攻西夏，西線由速不台、博爾朮等率騎兵追擊乃蠻汗太陽汗於蒙古西部；木華黎受命經略河北、山東的漢地軍務，與西夏戰線分進合擊，並以漢地降附諸軍截斷西夏與金朝之間的往來通道。西夏一方，以興慶府為國都，中書省掌政令、樞密院掌軍務，河西節度使司與州縣官分掌走廊防務；其軍以唐兀騎兵與城頭弩手為兩翼，沿興慶府至沙州一線分置屯田、城堡與烽燧，關內關外互為犄角。兩邊的軍隊都建在騎兵同農耕資源之上：西夏靠走廊綠洲的屯田、渠堰與馬場養兵，蒙古靠漠南牧群與漢地降附的糧秣，兩種體系在河西一撞，就變成一場比馬與粟的消耗。
countriesEn: The two sides were the Mongol Great Khanate and the Western Xia dynasty, known to Persian sources as the Tanguts. On the Mongol side, after sweeping up the Naiman and the Merkit in the southern steppe in the autumn of 1216, Genghis Khan turned due west and pointed his spear at Xingqing; the army still rested on the thousand-house and hundred-house units of the Mongol proper, with cavalry in the main, while for assault work it drew heavily on Han Chinese, Khitan and Jurchen officers and craftsmen who had surrendered, assigning them to fill ditches, carry ladders, dig tunnels and serve the artillery. In 1217 the Mongols fought on two fronts at once: in the east Genghis Khan led the central force against Western Xia himself, in the west Subutai and Boorchu rode down the Naiman khan Taishang in the western marches, while Muqali was left to manage Han Chinese affairs in Hebei and Shandong, advancing on a separate axis beside the Xia front and cutting the channel of communication between Western Xia and Jin. On the Xia side, Xingqing was the capital, the Secretariat handled civil government and the Privy Council the military, and the Hexi jiedushi together with the prefectural officers shared out the defence of the corridor. Their army relied on Tangut cavalry and on crossbowmen on the walls as its two wings, with farms, forts and beacon stations strung along the line from Xingqing to Shazhou, the positions inside and outside the frontier covering one another. The armies on both sides were built on cavalry and on agricultural resources: Xia raised its troops on the farms, the irrigation works and the grazing grounds of the oasis towns along the corridor, while the Mongols relied on the herds of the southern steppe and on the grain and fodder of the surrendered districts of Han China. Where the two systems met in the corridor it became a contest of horses and of millet.
people: 蒙古方面，決策與指揮集中於成吉思汗。他此次用兵目標明確：既要打通穿越河西走廊通往中亞的通道，又要取得西夏掌握的綠洲農地、牧場與馬匹，以支撐隨後的西征。速不台與博爾朮在西部追擊乃蠻汗太陽汗，迫其潰敗，使蒙古西面暫時無事；木華黎在東面主持漢地軍務，抽調河北、山東的降附將士參與西夏戰線，也切斷金朝對西夏的接應。西夏方面，時值襄宗嵬名安全在位，國政出自中書與樞密院，史料未留下明確的統帥姓名；能確定的是西夏以「恃弩精、能築城、諳水法」立國，故應戰重心放在興慶府城防與河西諸堡的聯防。文字方面，漢文有《元史·太祖本紀》《宋史·夏國傳》，波斯有志費尼《全史》與拉施特《史集》，雙方記述互補，才使這場在華文世界裡常被一句話帶過的戰役得以還原。值得留意的是漢地降將在這場戰爭裡的位置：他們熟悉城防、壕溝與水法，也清楚西夏各堡的短處，令蒙軍攻城時少靠蠻力。
peopleEn: On the Mongol side, decisions and command rested with Genghis Khan. His aims in this campaign were plain: to open a road through the Hexi Corridor towards Central Asia, and to take over the oasis farmland, pastures and horses held by Western Xia so as to feed the westward expedition that followed. Subutai and Boorchu pursued the Naiman khan Taishang in the west and scattered him, leaving the western flank secure for the moment; Muqali ran Han Chinese affairs in the east, drawing surrendered troops from Hebei and Shandong into the Xia front and severing the aid Jin could give. On the Xia side the ruler was Emperor Xiangzong, whose Tangut personal name was Weiliming Quanan, and the government was run by the Secretariat and the Privy Council; the sources name no commander in chief. What can be established is that Western Xia had founded itself on the saying that its crossbows were fierce, its fortifications skilled and its water works apt, so the reply to the attack was built around the defences of Xingqing and a chain of forts along the corridor. For the written record there are the chapter on Taizu in the Yuan Shi and the Xia chapter of the Song Shi in Chinese, and in Persian the Tarikh-i Jahan-gusha of Juvayni and the Jami al-tawarikh of Rashid al-Din; the two traditions check one another, and it is only by putting them side by side that a campaign usually dismissed in a single Chinese line can be reconstructed. The part played by the surrendered Han Chinese officers deserves notice: they knew walls, ditches and water works, and they knew where the Xia forts were weak, so the Mongols had less need to assault a city by brute force.
kits: 兵器卡上這件十字弩，在1217年的戰場上同時出現在攻守兩端，正對應卡面那句「城牆上它比長弓可靠，野戰裡它比長弓脆弱」。守方是西夏：唐兀弩手把弩立於城堞，強弩（宋人稱「神臂弓」）配鐵脊箭，射程遠過角弓，用以壓制城下填壕與扛梯的隊伍；宋沈括《夢溪筆談》與《宋史·夏國傳》都記有西夏神臂弓之事，宋廷得自來貢之器而仿造，遂以為城頭守備主力，可見這型弩在西夏軍中是標準配備。1209年蒙古攻興慶府時已吃過城頭弩手的厲害，那一役蒙古因攻城技藝不足而受挫。攻方是蒙古：其騎兵作戰靠反曲角弓與大量馬匹，並不倚賴弩；但攻城序列中必有弩手，用來在填壕、架雲梯、鑿地道的瞬間提供定點齊射，掩護進攻。這正是弩的定位——把射速交給機械，換來的是每分鐘一箭上下的裝填循環，遠慢於蒙古角弓合格射手每分鐘六箭上下的概略估算；野戰中弩手在馬背上幾乎無用，攻城中卻是進攻前的火力準備。
kitsEn: The crossbow on the weapon card stood on both sides of the 1217 field, which is exactly what the saying on the card means: on a wall it is dependable, in open country it is fragile. On the defensive side sat Western Xia, whose crossbowmen set their weapons on the parapets; the heavy crossbow, called the shenbi gong by the Song, with iron-shafted bolts, outranged the bow and was used to pin down the men filling the ditch and carrying ladders beneath the wall. Shen Kuo's Mengxi Bitan and the Xia chapter of the Song Shi both record the Xia shenbi gong: the Song court, having obtained such a weapon as tribute, had copies made and took it for the mainstay of wall defence, which shows that this type of crossbow was standard kit in the Xia army. The Mongols had already felt what the wall crossbowmen could do in 1209, when their attack on Xingqing was checked by the weakness of their own assault craft. On the attacking side stood the Mongols, whose cavalry fought with recurved composite bows and large numbers of horses and did not depend on the crossbow; yet a crossbow screen always appeared in the assault sequence, to deliver aimed volleys at the moment the ditches were filled, the scaling ladders lifted and the tunnels begun, covering the attack. That was the role of the weapon: it traded firing speed for mechanism and paid for it with a reload cycle of about one arrow a minute, far slower than the rough estimate of six arrows a minute for a skilled Mongol composite-bow archer. On horseback in the field the crossbowman was almost useless; before a city wall he was the preparation for the assault.
tactics: 蒙古的戰術主軸是「先取通道、再取城」。此前1211年蒙古已借韋端子之亂的名義攻入西夏，奪取河套一帶；1209年攻興慶府時因缺水缺草，遠征之師折損在瀚海與黃河之間，學到沙漠戰必須依賴綠洲補給。1217年蒙古改以河西走廊為主攻方向：騎兵自漠南與河套出發，沿賀蘭山麓與走廊東段直取興慶府，擄取屯田、驅趕牲畜，並以輕騎分隊斷絕興慶府與甘州、肅州、沙州之間的聯絡，迫西夏放棄外圍堡塞、退守首都。攻城時仍採漢地匠人教練的巢車、撞車、雲梯與鑿地諸法，並在壕溝對面架起弩手陣地，用定點射擊覆蓋進攻通道。西夏的應對是守城與拖延：城牆以夯土築成，環城引黃河水為濠，開門放水淹營；城頭弩手居高射擊，輕騎由兩翼出城反衝，焚燒蒙古攻城器械與草料；同時遣使往金、宋方向求援，並以和談拖延時日，等蒙古主力因西征花剌子模而轉向。
tacticsEn: The Mongol plan was to take the road first and the city second. In 1211 they had already entered Western Xia under the pretext of the revolt of the Weidu tribes and taken the Hetao region; in 1209 their attempt on Xingqing had cost them dearly in the desert between the Yellow River and the Gobi for want of water and fodder, and they had learned that a desert war must be supplied from the oases. So in 1217 they made the Hexi Corridor the main axis: cavalry left the southern steppe and the Hetao, ran along the foot of the Helan range and the eastern corridor to strike Xingqing, took the farms and drove off the herds, and sent light detachments to cut the links between Xingqing and Ganzhou, Suzhou and Shazhou, forcing Xia to abandon the outer forts and fall back on the capital. For the siege they still used the methods drilled by Han Chinese engineers, the siege tower, the ram, the scaling ladder and the mine, and they set up crossbow lines across the ditch whose aimed fire covered the approach. The Xia answer was to hold and to stall: the wall was rammed earth, the Yellow River was led round the city to fill the ditch, and the sluices were opened to drown the camp; crossbowmen on the walls shot down, light cavalry rode out from both flanks to strike the assault columns and burn the Mongol siege gear and fodder; envoys went to Jin and Song for help, and negotiations were used to gain time until the Mongol main force turned west towards Khwarezm.
data: 先記名稱：中文戰爭名錄把1217年的一役題作「蒙古攻西遼之戰」，但1217年蒙古與西遼（喀喇契丹）並無交戰；西遼要到1218年蒙古那場迦勒迦河之役才被吞併，與本卷另一條1223年迦勒迦河之役（蒙古征羅斯與欖察聯軍）並非同役；1217年蒙古唯一一次向西用兵是對西夏，故本文依實戰記之。數字上，可查的多是概略：蒙古出動兵力為數萬騎兵的規模，史料未留確數；自漠南或河套營地至興慶府直線約七百至一千公里，興慶府至甘州（今甘肅張掖）約五百五十公里，至沙州（今甘肅敦煌）超過一千公里。器械方面，弩的裝填循環約需半分鐘至一分鐘，合格弩手每分鐘約一至二箭，蒙古反曲角弓每分鐘約六箭；重型弩有效射程約二百至三百五十公尺，遠勝角弓。波斯史家志費尼把甘、肅二州之役記於回曆615年（1218至1219），與漢文所記1217年的攻勢前後相銜；另有1219年蒙古文碑刻傳世，記有蒙軍在河西走廊的戰場地名與徵糧紀錄，可作旁證。
dataEn: First the name: the Chinese list of wars records the 1217 engagement as the Mongol war against Western Liao, but the Mongols fought no war with the Western Liao, the Qara Khitai, in 1217; that state was swallowed only in 1218, at the Mongols' own battle on the Kalka, a different affair from the 1223 clash on the same river against the Rus and the Cumans that appears elsewhere in this collection; the one western campaign the Mongols mounted in 1217 was against Western Xia, so this account follows the fighting as it actually happened. The figures that can be had are mostly rough. The Mongol force was of the order of tens of thousands of horsemen, and the sources leave no exact number. From the camps in the southern steppe or in the Hetao to Xingqing the straight line is roughly seven hundred to a thousand kilometres; from Xingqing to Ganzhou, present-day Zhangye in Gansu, about five hundred and fifty kilometres, and to Shazhou, present-day Dunhuang, rather more than a thousand. As for equipment, the reload cycle of a crossbow takes about half a minute to a minute, a trained crossbowman gets off one or two bolts a minute, and a skilled Mongol composite-bow archer some six; the effective range of a heavy crossbow is about two hundred to three hundred and fifty metres, well beyond the bow. The Persian historian Juvayni dates the fall of Ganzhou and Suzhou to AH 615, that is 1218 to 1219, which runs straight on from the 1217 offensive recorded in the Chinese; there is also a Mongolian inscription of 1219 carrying place names of the battlefields in the corridor and the record of grain requisitioned, which serves as a second witness.
cause: 打起來的緣由有三層。第一是蒙古自身的整合：1211年以韋端子之亂為名攻西夏、奪得河套，1216年又在西境追滅乃蠻、蔑兒乞，成吉思汗此時已握有橫貫草原的騎兵大軍，東面受金朝牽制、南面未定，正需要一個穩定的西部後方。第二是通道與補給：河西走廊是從漠南通往中亞的唯一陸路，興慶府與沙州之間的綠洲、牧場、馬群與屯田全在西夏手中；蒙古若要西征，必須先由西夏手中取得走廊的通行權與糧秣。第三是西夏的態度：西夏自恃強弩、精騎與城防，向蒙古貢賦屢次拖延，1211年後又拒絕依命出兵，成吉思汗遂在1217年再以兵戎解決。此外，1217年蒙古西征乃蠻同時解決了西面的後顧之憂，使這一仗可以打成一次有明確政治目標的進攻。第四層是攻城教訓：1211年以來蒙古屢攻興慶府不得志，已知硬攻城池代價太高，故這次把目標由奪城改成奪路。
causeEn: There were three layers to the reason for the fighting. The first was the internal consolidation of the Mongols: having taken Western Xia in 1211 under the pretext of the revolt of the Weidu tribes and seized the Hetao, and having destroyed the Naiman and the Merkit in the west in 1216, Genghis Khan now held a cavalry host that stretched across the steppe, hemmed in on the east by the Jin and unsettled in the south, and needed a settled western rear. The second was road and supply: the Hexi Corridor was the only land route from the southern steppe to Central Asia, and every oasis, pasture, herd of horses and farm between Xingqing and Shazhou lay in Xia hands; before the Mongols could march west they had to take the right of passage and the grain of that corridor from Western Xia. The third was Xia behaviour: confident in its crossbows, its cavalry and its walls, it kept stalling over the tribute it owed, and after 1211 it refused the Muster, so Genghis Khan settled the matter by arms in 1217. In addition, the campaign against the Naiman in 1217 removed the western worry at one stroke, and so the war could be fought as a deliberate advance with a clear political purpose. A fourth layer was the lesson of the assault: repeated attacks on Xingqing since 1211 had shown that storming a walled city at excessive cost achieved little, so the object of this campaign was changed from taking the city to taking the road.
impact: 最直接的一項後果，是河西走廊從西夏的屏障變成蒙古的通道。蒙古由此取得往中亞的陸路與穩定後方，1219年才得以分三路西征花剌子模，1220至1221年間滅其國、1221年追至迦勒迦河，隨後建立橫跨歐亞的蒙古帝國版圖；這條路的補給與政治前提，正是在1217至1218年河西一役奠定的。第二，西夏的國力結構被削去一支。河西走廊的灌溉農地、牧場與軍馬是西夏自立以來最重要的資源之一，失去沙、肅、甘一線後，疆域縮為興慶府與河套一帶，國勢自此一落千丈。第三，武器層面的教訓被兩個方向同時記下：蒙古從西夏的城頭弩與水法學到攻城與守城之別；西夏則看到角弓配大量騎兵在機動戰中不可替代——同一場戰役裡，弩守住了城頭的某一刻，卻擋不住整條走廊易手。技術上亦有後續：蒙古自伊斯蘭世界攜走工程師與器械工藝，令配重投射器與火藥兵器在蒙古軍中更見通行；西夏這邊失去走廊的同時，也交出了一批熟悉漢式城防與水利的匠人與降將，令蒙古往後攻中原城池的手段更齊。
impactEn: The most immediate consequence was that the Hexi Corridor changed from a Xia barrier into a Mongol road. The Mongols thereby gained a land route to Central Asia and a settled rear, and only in 1219 could they march west against Khwarezm in three columns, destroy that state in 1220 and 1221, pursue the flying enemy to the Kalka in 1221, and then set up a Mongol empire spanning Eurasia; the supply and the political preconditions of that road were fixed by the campaign in the corridor in 1217 and 1218. Second, one whole limb was cut from the economic structure of Western Xia. The irrigated land, the pastures and the warhorses of the corridor had been the most important resources of Xia since the state was founded, and after the loss of the line of Shazhou, Suzhou and Ganzhou its territory shrank to Xingqing and the Hetao, and its strength fell away from that day. Third, the lesson in arms was written down from both directions at once: the Mongols learned from the Xia wall crossbow and water works the difference between assaulting and defending, while Xia saw in the same campaign the irreplaceable part played by the composite bow backed by massed cavalry in a war of movement. In one and the same campaign the crossbow held the wall for a moment, and could not keep the corridor from changing hands. There were technical consequences as well: the Mongols carried engineers and the craft of siege machinery away with them from the Islamic world, which made the counterweight thrower and gunpowder weapons more common in Mongol service; and Xia, in losing the corridor, at the same time handed over a set of craftsmen and surrendered officers who knew Han Chinese fortification and water works, so that the Mongols went on to the cities of the Central Plain with a fuller set of means.
result: 打到1217年末至1218年初，西夏遣使請和，條件包括交出人質、按年進貢、割讓河西走廊西段與草場，並開放嘉峪關一帶的關隘供蒙軍通行；蒙古取得進攻中亞所需的通道、糧秣與馬匹，得以在1219年把主力轉向花剌子模。和平維持了一年多：西夏未按約出兵助蒙，1219年成吉思汗以違約為由再伐西夏，西夏在河西沿線的堡塞再遭進攻，蒙古才抽身西行。西夏作為獨立的王朝，此時已名存實亡，其領土與軍力都被壓縮到興慶府周邊；1226年蒙古再舉大軍，1227年西夏滅亡，成吉思汗本人亦在那一役中去世。河西諸堡此後多由兩家共守，西夏仍奉正統名號，走廊的商旅、草場與驛傳實際上歸蒙古調度，這種名義與實力分離的狀態維持到1226年最後一役。回頭看1217年，這一仗並未在戰場上徹底摧毀西夏，卻決定了西夏餘生的走向，也決定了蒙古帝國往西擴張的第一個支點。
resultEn: By the end of 1217 and the beginning of 1218 Western Xia sent envoys to ask for terms: hostages given over, tribute paid year by year, the western stretch of the Hexi Corridor and its pastures ceded, and the passes around Jiayuguan opened so that Mongol armies could pass; the Mongols gained the road, the grain and the horses they needed to strike at Central Asia, and were able to turn the main force towards Khwarezm in 1219. The peace lasted a little over a year. Xia did not furnish the troops it had promised to the Mongols, and in 1219 Genghis Khan marched against it again on the ground of the breach, the forts along the river in the corridor were attacked once more, and only then did the Mongols draw off to the west. As an independent dynasty Western Xia was already a name and nothing more; its territory and its army had been pressed back to the neighbourhood of Xingqing. In 1226 the Mongols raised a great army again, in 1227 Western Xia was destroyed, and Genghis Khan himself died in that campaign. The forts of the corridor were afterwards often held jointly, and Xia kept the nominal title of the legitimate ruler while the trade, the pastures and the posting of orders along the road were in Mongol hands; that split between name and substance lasted until the last campaign of 1226. Looked back on from 1217, the war did not break Western Xia on the field, but it settled the shape of the rest of Xia's life, and it fixed the first foothold of the Mongol empire's westward expansion.
